headline: South Africa's Mr Price Revenue Rises 41% to R26.1 Billion Following NKD Deal
summary: South African fashion retailer Mr Price reported a 41% surge in total revenue to R26.1 billion, driven by the consolidation of newly acquired European apparel chain NKD.
why: Mr Price Group is one of South Africa's largest value fashion and home goods retail chains listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

impacts.name: Mr Price Group
impacts.why: Revenue jumped 41% due to the inclusion of newly acquired retailer NKD.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
